data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month, and the same whenever stock is 500. With 25 fishers, that leaves 250 tons, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome and supporting $10,000 each per month indefinitely. If stock falls below 500, let's adjust together to preserve recovery. I intend to take 10 if this plan gains broad support. Who will join?
